title: PR-body headline claims audio.dem proves 'ALL FOUR kinds' — contradicted by its own W1 fix and the code
evidence: _pr_body.md:17: "`audio.dem` now proves ALL FOUR kinds fire (wire via its 100 ms draws); the new `audio_spawn.dem` (T1-only, growth on) proves the spawn chime + wire in a growth context." vs _pr_body.md:65-66: "W1 — \"ALL FOUR kinds\" reworded" (`harness/run.odin`, `demos/audio.dem` header): audio.dem proves crisis+arrival+wire; spawn lives in audio_spawn.dem" and demos/audio.dem:19: "# so the consumer exercises THREE kinds in this golden: 1 crisis sting draw" and harness/run.odin:508: "// NO growth on, so NODE_SPAWNED cannot fire here — spawn lives in"
detail: Spec AC says 'wire, spawn, crisis, delivery all fire' — true across both goldens, but the W1-corrected claim was not applied to the headline Golden-proof bullet, which still overstates audio.dem (no growth on, so NODE_SPAWNED cannot fire there).
recommended_fix: Reword _pr_body.md:17 to 'audio.dem proves crisis+arrival+wire; audio_spawn.dem proves spawn+wire — all four kinds covered across the golden family.'
